motion.engine: Native scrolling, IntersectionObserver and one shared event-driven requestAnimationFrame scheduler. Layout reads precede writes; no idle animation loop.
motion.intent: Follow four everyday Saudi sharing stories without replacing ordinary document scrolling
motion.signature: Silent edge opening, separate kernel reveal, then empty husks arc into a paper pouch. Four fixed-crop photographic beats per flavour advance and reverse with scroll position.
supporting: Scroll-driven text opacity/18px entrance and section underline reveal
Three unpinned visual care cards: seed/kernel drift, four sachets spreading, then a shared family moment
24px total photographic drift with a fixed 1.06 crop scale
Product drift capped at32px desktop and19px phone, with restrained rotation; controls stay stationary
motion.mobile: At760px and below, existing story panels pin only when viewport height exceeds620px and the measured panel fits. Four beats use the available native scroll travel. Shorter screens keep document flow.
motion.reduced_motion: No entrance, drift, crossfade or pinning. Every four-frame sequence becomes a labelled static grid; gallery containers expand to avoid clipping.
motion.without_javascript: Each scene is visible inline; no content relies on motion for comprehension.
motion.performance_evidence: Independent Node checks passed event coalescing, reads-before-writes, idle shutdown, unsubscribe and visibility recovery. Desktop1440x900 and phone390x844 scrolling observed in browser. CPU-throttled frame rate and physical-device GPU performance were not measured.
motion.ritual: Silent scroll animation: three-quarter closed seed opens along curved right edge using complementary clips and a restrained tip-first pivot; two empty inner husks separate, kernel emerges, husks drop behind bag front.
motion.ritual_mobile: Sticky panel capped at680px or viewport minus18px, with large captions above a separately bounded art plane. Height480px or below, reduced motion and no JavaScript show a static exploded guide.
